Ajay starts from Point A and drives 12 km towards the east. He then takes a right turn, drives 3 km, turns right and drives 18 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 11 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 6 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again?(All turns are 90 degree turns only unless specified).
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (8 km to the south) है।

Each of P, Q, R, S, T, U and V has an exam on a different day of a week, starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week. P has the exam on Friday. Only three people have exams before R. S has the exam before U but after V. Q has the exam before T, but after P. How many people have exams between V and P?67

Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.Statements: All almonds are crows.Some pots are razors.All razors are crows.Conclusions: (I) All pots are crows.(II) Some almonds are razors.21
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.) है।

A statement is given followed by two courses of actions, numbered I and II. You must assume everything in the statement to be true and on the basis of the information given in the statement, decide which of the given courses of action(s) logically follow(s) for pursuing.Statement:A rise in the price of tomatoes in state X has been reported in the past 5 months. This is due to the shortage of tomatoes in state X owing to the export of tomatoes to other states.Courses of Action:I) The Government of State X should impose a limit to the export of tomatoes to other states during peak seasons.II) The Government of State X should impose a maximum price above which tomatoes can’t be sold in state.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Only I follows) है।

In this question, a statement is given followed by two courses of action, numbered I and II. You must assume everything in the statement to be true, and on the basis of the information given in the statement, decide which of the given courses of action logically follow(s) for pursuing.Statement: Numerous students participating in the Board X examinations have conveyed their disappointment regarding questions that fall outside the prescribed syllabus and exhibit inadequate syntax.Courses of Action:I. Board X should check questions that have issues and adequately compensate students with marks for those questions.II. Board X should conduct a comprehensive review of the procedures involved in the preparation of examination papers to prevent the recurrence of such incidents in the future.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Both I and II follow) है।
